en: Black-and-white street scene showing an elegant late‑19th‑century European boulevard. Tall four‑story buildings with ornate facades, arched windows, shutters, wrought‑iron balconies, and striped awnings line the street. A prominent corner establishment with a sign reading "Café" has decorative lamps and large curtained windows. Well‑dressed pedestrians in early 20th‑century attire—long dresses, hats, and suits—stroll and converse along the sidewalk; some café tables are visible in the foreground under a large tree.
